CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rakeezx.apply_sync_v2_teaching_creation_command(p_mutation_id text, p_device_id text, p_teaching_id text, p_section_id text, p_subject_id text, p_term_id text, p_order integer, p_item_ids jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, p_client_updated_at bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ begin
      if auth.uid() is null then raise exception using errcode='42501',message='Authentication required'; end if;
      perform rakeezx.lock_student_lifecycle(auth.uid());
      return rakeezx.apply_sync_v2_teaching_creation_command_before_student_0029(p_mutation_id,p_device_id,p_teaching_id,p_section_id,p_subject_id,p_term_id,p_order,p_item_ids,p_client_updated_at); end; $function$
